segments.name: Lihir
segments.description: Open pit gold mine on Aniolam Island, Papua New Guinea, producing gold doré that is refined and sold.
segments.evidence: Our Lihir operation, which comprises an open pit mine that produces gold doré, is located on the island of Aniolam, PNG.

segments.name: Cadia
segments.description: Underground panel cave gold and copper mine in New South Wales, Australia, producing concentrate and gold doré.
segments.evidence: The processing plant infrastructure includes high pressure grinding rolls, SAG mills, ball mills, flotation, coarse ore flotation, gravity concentrator and a molybdenum plant to produce copper and gold concentrate, gold doré, and molybdenum concentrate.

segments.name: Tanami
segments.description: Underground gold mine in Australia's Northern Territory whose ore is processed at the Granites into gold doré.
segments.evidence: Tanami reported 5.3 million ounces of gold reserves at December 31, 2025.

segments.name: Boddington
segments.description: Open pit gold and copper mine in Western Australia producing gold doré and copper concentrate for smelters and refiners.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, Boddington reported 10.2 million and 10.8 million ounces of gold reserves, respectively, and 0.5 million and 0.5 million tonnes of copper reserves, respectively.

segments.name: Ahafo South
segments.description: Gold operation in the Ahafo Region of Ghana, mined from open pit and underground deposits and producing gold doré.
segments.evidence: The Ahafo South mine is composed of three orogenic gold deposits that have oxide and primary mineralization.

segments.name: Ahafo North
segments.description: Open pit gold operation in Ghana that reached commercial production in 2025 and produces gold doré.
segments.evidence: The Ahafo North mine is comprised of six open pit orogenic gold deposits with both oxide and primary mineralization.

segments.name: Merian
segments.description: Open pit gold mine in Suriname, held with a partner, producing gold doré for refining.
segments.evidence: All of the gold mineralization at Merian is closely associated with quartz veining within siltstone and sandstone formations.

segments.name: Cerro Negro
segments.description: Underground gold and silver mine in southern Argentina producing doré bars shipped to a refinery.
segments.evidence: Deposits within the Cerro Negro mine operations are low sulfidation, epithermal gold/silver vein deposits.

segments.name: Yanacocha
segments.description: Gold mine in Peru with leach pads and processing plants that produce gold doré.
segments.evidence: Yanacocha also has three gold processing plants (Pampa Larga, Yanacocha Norte and La Quinua), one limestone processing facility (China Linda) and one mill (Yanacocha Gold Mill).

segments.name: Peñasquito
segments.description: Open pit mine in Mexico producing gold doré plus silver, lead and zinc concentrates from flotation.
segments.evidence: The mineralization at Peñasquito contains gold, silver, lead and zinc.

segments.name: Red Chris
segments.description: Copper and gold open pit mine in British Columbia producing gold, copper and silver concentrate.
segments.evidence: We hold a 70% interest in the Red Chris operation, which comprises an open pit mine that produces gold, copper and silver concentrate, located in British Columbia, Canada.

segments.name: Brucejack
segments.description: Underground gold and silver mine in British Columbia producing doré and flotation concentrate.
segments.evidence: Our Brucejack operation, which comprises an underground mine that produces gold/silver doré and flotation concentrate and hosts the Valley of the Kings high-grade gold deposit, is also located in British Columbia, Canada.

revenueModel.text: Refiners and smelters pay Newmont for gold doré, refined gold and copper, silver, lead and zinc concentrate, which investors and fabricators then buy as bullion, coins and jewelry.
revenueModel.evidence: Copper, silver, lead, and zinc sales are generally in the form of concentrate that is sold to smelters for further treatment and refining.

changes.evidence: the sale of the CC&V, Musselwhite, and Éléonore reportable segments in the first quarter of 2025, the sale of the Porcupine and Akyem reportable segments in the second quarter of 2025

changes.text: In 2024 the Company completed the sale of the Telfer reportable segment.
changes.evidence: The Company completed the sale of the assets of the Telfer reportable segment in the fourth quarter of 2024

changes.text: In 2025 Ahafo North was classified as a reportable segment after commercial production was declared.
changes.evidence: In October 2025, the Company declared commercial production at its Ahafo North project in Ghana resulting in classification as a reportable segment.
